headline: Sensex ends volatile session marginally higher with Nifty around 25,299 as realty stocks lead gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Realty and banking stocks outperformed, supporting the benchmark indices.
Optimism surrounding foreign capital inflows lifted market sentiment.
Significant gains in auto and aviation stocks boosted benchmark performance.
Concerns over October retail inflation surge weighed on market sentiment regarding potential rate hikes.
whatHappening: Sensex ended a volatile trading session marginally higher while Nifty closed around 25,299.
Realty sector stocks surged up to 4% during the trading session.
Gold prices slumped to the lowest level in over a year.
NITI Aayog report revealed PLI schemes met 28% of their employment target by FY26.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally higher in a volatile session with Nifty near 25,300. Realty and financial stocks led the market, while auto and aviation counters like M&M and IndiGo registered strong gains. Retail inflation surge raised concerns over potential interest rate hikes.
